scope: RecallWeave #72: separate native question-selection rehearsal; no learner/model/validator changes
acceptance: A supplied deck passes unchanged parseDeck/validateDeck; its checked content/order/identity/attribution is retained.
Model functions and DEFAULT_BKT remain byte-exact and fixed. Only hypothetical starting probabilities vary, with exactly all known concepts, finite numbers in inclusive [0,1].

Actual native selectNextItem chooses every question. The lab never makes prerequisite links hard gates. Displayed EIG calls native expectedInformationGain; the documented direct-unanswered/capped-at-three repair component must agree with the native winner and original localeCompare tie behavior.
The two previews and committed synthetic steps call native updateMastery on the chosen concept. Other concepts remain unchanged; the chosen ID becomes asked exactly once.

Undo restores the complete previous native state; stepping again after undo removes the abandoned future. Restart keeps the applied starting assumptions and deck; defaults explicitly restores published initial values.

Changing and applying starting assumptions starts a fresh synthetic experiment. Unapplied or invalid starting edits cannot produce a stale downloadable/steppable result; discarding edits restores the current experiment.
Exhaustion yields no selected question or further step, while undo/restart/export remain coherent.

Local file selection is previewed before explicit replacement. Cancel/refusal preserves the current experiment. Superseded reads and reads made stale by rehearsal or starting-input changes cannot replace it.
All deck/filename text remains inert literal text. Direct-file output requires no network/account/storage/provider.

Export is a new synthetic-experiment report, not a learner/lesson archive; it includes exact checked course content, fixed parameters, applied starting assumptions, retained boolean synthetic responses, exact question IDs and full-precision before/after/native-next states. It captures the active experiment rather than any pending file preview.

export_contract.syntheticResponses: ordered booleans, one per retained synthetic step
export_contract.current: mastery, asked IDs, native selectedQuestionId/null, remaining, candidate explanation rows and two hypothetical branches/empty

independent_scope: Author a separate multi-concept deck and original-native oracle before candidate exposure. Receive actual browser selection/step/undo/restart/file/export integration and native source preservation; do not repeat author matrix. No candidate cases or implementation are part of this baseline handoff.
